mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate decline below 3.0% signals active monetary easing, reducing borrowing costs and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS < 3.0) with t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between HOUST and RSAFS is not significant (p > 0.05) in predicting 60-day SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity, reducing corporate earnings visibility and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day SPX returns is greater than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 2050 thousand units signal robust housing market activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods (HOUST > 2050) with t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.0%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.5%) indicates a stable monetary environment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced risk premiums.
failure_condition: The joint effect of FEDFUNDS < 3.0% and CPIAUCSL < 2.5% is not significant (p > 0.05) in predicting 20-day SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO > 120) signals robust manufacturing activity and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 120 (t-test p > 0.05 for positive returns).
